description: Source code for an Android inspection tool that detects missing onClick handlers in Android layout XML files within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

classes.name: AndroidMissingOnClickHandlerInspection
classes.description: An inspection tool class for detecting missing onClick handlers in Android layout XML files.

classes.name: MyVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class that traverses XML attribute values to identify missing or incorrect onClick handler methods.

classes.name: MyQuickFix
classes.description: Quick fix class to create missing onClick handler methods in Java classes.

methods.name: findRelatedActivities
methods.description: Finds related activity classes for a given XML file, based on layout or menu description.

methods.name: findRelatedActivitiesForMenu
methods.description: Finds activity classes related to a menu XML file.

methods.name: findActivityClass
methods.description: Locates the activity class in the project module.

methods.name: checkFile
methods.description: Main method that performs the inspection on a given XML file.

methods.name: visitXmlAttributeValue
methods.description: Visits XML attribute values to identify references to onClick methods and check their correctness.

methods.name: reportMissingOnClickProblem
methods.description: Reports problems related to missing or incorrect onClick handler methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the quick fix action.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the display text of the quick fix.

methods.name: getFamilyName
methods.description: Returns the family name for the quick fix.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes the quick fix to create the missing method and navigate to it.

methods.name: doApplyFix
methods.description: Applies the fix to add the handler method.

methods.name: getShortName
methods.description: Extracts the short class name from a full class name.
